claims.claim: Canon EOS D650 (i.e. EOS 650D) DSLR Camera
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows 'Canon' and 'EOS 650D' text on the camera body.
Photo 2 top-down view shows zoom ring markings 18-24-35-55, consistent with an 18-55mm kit lens range.
No photo shows the camera powered on, LCD lit, or a sample shot; functionality cannot be confirmed from stills.
Lens cap is on and sensor/LCD surface are not shown; cosmetic and optical cleanliness cannot be judged from these angles.
No import label, region sticker, or box/manual shown to confirm origin.

claims.claim: Model is 750D (external note, not from witness or seller text)
claims.evidence: Photo 0 clearly reads 'EOS 650D' on the body; identity is fixed by the witness and cannot be overridden by an unverified side statement.

risks.risk: Shutter actuation count unknown, affects mechanical life expectancy
risks.proof: Screenshot of in-camera menu or EXIF data showing shutter count
risks.if_unproven: priced as high/unknown shutter count (worst case)

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or may have internal fault despite claim of 'working perfectly'
risks.proof: Short video clip of camera powering on, screen lighting up, and taking a test shot

risks.risk: LCD screen condition (cracks, dead pixels, dim backlight) not visible since screen is closed
risks.proof: Photo of screen open and displaying a live image
risks.if_unproven: priced as faulty/damaged screen until proven

risks.risk: Lens glass condition (scratches, fungus, dust, haze) hidden by lens cap
risks.proof: Photo of lens with cap off, held up to light from both front and rear elements
risks.if_unproven: priced as having optical defects until proven

risks.risk: Missing accessories (battery, charger, memory card, strap, box)
risks.proof: Photo of all included accessories laid out together
risks.if_unproven: priced as body+lens only, no accessories

risks.risk: Physical damage to bottom plate, battery compartment, or mount not visible from shown angles
risks.proof: Photo of camera base, battery door open, and lens mount with lens detached
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming possible hidden physical damage

risks.risk: Sensor condition (dust, scratches, dead pixels) cannot be assessed
risks.proof: Test photo against plain white/blue sky background stopped down to f/16
risks.if_unproven: priced as having sensor dust/damage until proven

proof_requests: Video of camera powering on, menu navigation, and taking a test shot
Photo of screen open and displaying an image
Photo of lens elements (front and rear) with caps off, under good light
Photo of camera bottom, battery compartment open, and lens mount
Photo showing shutter count from menu or EXIF data of a test photo
Photo of all included accessories (battery, charger, card, box, strap)
response.reason: Witness confirms a Canon EOS 650D with kit lens, so it can be priced at worst case; functionality, cosmetic condition, and accessory completeness remain unverified and should be priced conservatively until supporting shots are provided.
